subject.title: fix(web-fetch): extract full HTML body content

question: Should title-only Readability output preserve the documented provider-before-basic-HTML fallback order, even when that means configured providers may be called on pages current main returns locally?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and tested, but choosing provider-first recovery is a compatibility, latency, and possible provider-cost tradeoff that should be owned by a maintainer rather than inferred from green tests.

options.title: Accept provider-first recovery
options.body: Merge the current fallback order once a maintainer accepts the extra provider call as the intended behavior for title-only Readability output.

options.title: Prefer local body cleanup first
options.body: Ask for title-only pages to use body-scoped raw HTML cleanup before provider fallback to avoid provider latency and credits at the cost of changing the documented order.

options.title: Wait for exact live repro
options.body: Pause until the reporter or maintainer supplies the original page if the team wants live URL proof before choosing the fallback policy.

recommendation.title: Accept provider-first recovery
recommendation.body: Merge the current fallback order once a maintainer accepts the extra provider call as the intended behavior for title-only Readability output.

likelyOwner.reason: The readability and fallback history is strongest in Peter Steinberger's commits, and this decision is about preserving or changing that fallback contract.
